title: Gender Stereotypes in Professional Roles Among Saudis: An Analytical Study of AI-Generated Images Using Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images of 56 Saudi professions using gender-neutral prompts across three text-to-image models, followed by human annotation to evaluate perceived gender distribution and adherence to stereotypical gender roles and activities.

Human evaluation of AI-generated images to assess the cultural accuracy and appropriateness of clothing, appearance, backgrounds, and settings specifically within the context of Saudi Arabian professional and societal norms.
Human annotation categorizing the perceived age (youth vs. elderly) of the depicted professionals to detect age-based stereotyping and demographic imbalances across different occupational roles.
